description: Forcefully kill a session (SIGKILL) and release it — the escape hatch when stop hangs. Pass sessionId to target a specific session. Returns: { ok, session_id, killed: true }. Errors: NOT_RUNNING (no such session; not retryable), BAD_ARGUMENT (multiple sessions live — pass sessionId).

sessionId.description: Target session id. Omit when a single session is running.

name: electron_force_kill
title: Force-kill Electron app
